entry.title: Development :: RE: New programming language MasterBASIC
entry.dc:creator: The Virtual Constructs
entry.dc:subject: Development
entry.content:
Author: The Virtual Constructs
Posted: Fri Nov 06, 2026 11:53 am (GMT 0)

IllusionOfMana wrote
Going to be a bit critical here...
And maybe its because I can't see the viability of this over the range of development options we already have for the SMS...
I dont see why anyone would pick this over like a visual code node based dev environment, if they wanted to go easy. We also have the C implementation, for those looking for a middle ground between that and ASM.
Heck, I met someone the other day that made a C# like implementation that builds to GB, NES, GG, and SMS...

Im just curious. Why would I or anyone be compelled to pick this over those options? A good answer to that may help others get over the AI junk that's surrounding this.


Its a useful project as it gives a "measuring stick" of how human made only tools versus AI made tools compare in the present day. However it isn't something I would personally use.
